title: Pushing Ice
author: Reynolds, Alastair
review:
I really enjoyed this a lot. Reynolds grabs you right away with a couple interesting mysteries that have big implications for their scientific impact.

This book also was much different from what I was expecting, I was expecting something a bit more grounded and having harder scientific foundations, but I did really like what I ended up getting.

Will be reading more Reynolds very soon, both of the standalone novels I've read have been hits with me.
